cases.title: Verify Main Title Display
cases.description: Verify that the main title 'Number To Words Conversion' is prominently displayed at the top of the page within an HTML element with the class 'heading' immediately upon page load.

cases.title: Real-time Conversion for Valid Numbers
cases.description: Enter valid numeric values into the input field with data-testid 'input-box' and verify that the corresponding word representation is displayed in the output paragraph with data-testid 'output-paragraph' in black text.

cases.title: Input Validation for Non-Numeric Characters
cases.description: Enter non-numeric characters into the input box and verify that the error message 'Invalid input. Please enter only digits.' is displayed in red text.

cases.title: Input Validation for Numbers Exceeding 15 Digits
cases.description: Enter a number exceeding 15 digits into the input box and verify that the error message 'Too Large Number.' is displayed in red text.

cases.title: Handling Zero and Leading Zeros
cases.description: Enter zero or numbers with leading zeros into the input box and verify that 'Zero' or the correctly converted number with ignored leading zeros is displayed in black text.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements accurately, are distinct, testable, and have no blockers.
The test cases and requirements are well-defined, clear, and testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_603-R-1 testable behavior: verifying the main title 'Number To Words Conversion' is visible immediately upon page load inside an HTML element with class 'heading'. Boundaries: immediate visibility on load, exact text match. Normal paths: successful render of title with correct CSS. Abnormal paths: missing class, incorrect text, or delayed load. Ambiguities: none. Requirement e2edev_bench_603-R-2 testable behavior: real-time conversion of numeric input from input-box (data-testid) to output-paragraph (data-testid) with padding logic making length divisible by 3. Boundaries: 15-digit limit, non-numeric characters, zero input, leading zeros. Normal paths: valid numeric inputs (with or without leading zeros) converted to words in black text. Abnormal paths: non-numeric input triggering 'Invalid input. Please enter only digits.' in red text; numbers exceeding 15 digits triggering 'Too Large Number.' in red text. Ambiguities: exact definition of padding behavior for edge cases.
